pages.title: Ignis
pages.text: $(bold)Cataclysm's Burning Arena: Ignis's ignitium and its armour, the bulwark of the flame and its gauntlet, the incinerator and the immolator, and the embers and ashes of its berserkers and revenants.$(br2)$(thing)Relics$(n), ring 11.$(br)$(thing)56 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After The Netherite Monstrosity.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill Ignis$(n)$(br2)Pays 10 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
